result.description: InvestorKit  The Business Innovation Analyst plays a pivotal role at InvestorKit, sitting at the intersection of our Strategy and Technology divisions. You will work closely with the Portfolio Strategists to understand how clients are being served, identify friction points in the strategy journey, and translate those insights into precise technical requirements and software solutions that help the team scale with quality.  You will be responsible for ensuring the tools, systems, and processes that underpin the Strategy division are fit for purpose — championing software quality through rigorous testing, documenting how we work, and enabling our Strategists to spend more time delivering exceptional client outcomes and less time navigating process gaps.  From day one, you will have a tangible impact on revenue and client outcomes, working alongside a talented, mission-driven team that will invest in your growth both personally and professionally       Benefits   Opportunity to work on ICT projects and business process improvement initiatives. Opportunity to contribute to a growing, technology-driven organisation.    Task & responsibilities  The responsibilities outlined below represent the core expectations of the role. As a team member at InvestorKit, you are also expected to actively uphold our values, contribute to our mission, and make decisions that support our vision of becoming Australia’s leading buyers agency. Facilitate workshops with the Strategy division to map current workflows, identify inefficiencies, and gather detailed requirements for improvement. Use project management software to monitor tasks, deadlines, and resource allocation.  Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to address project challenges proactively.  Conduct regular project status meetings with team members and stakeholders to keep everyone informed.  Prepare and distribute project status reports, highlighting key achievements, upcoming tasks, and issues.    Support the Strategy Division    Support the build and continuous improvement of CRM workflows, portfolio tracking tools, and client milestone systems used daily by the Strategy team.  Participate in Strategy team meetings and Data & AI huddles to stay close to operational priorities and emerging needs.  Analyse data from CRM and portfolio systems to surface trends, gaps, and opportunities that inform strategic decision-making.  Contribute to the development of frameworks, scripts, and tools that help Strategists deliver more consistent, high-quality client outcomes at scale.    Gather and Document Business Requirements    Organise and conduct requirement-gathering sessions with stakeholders and subject matter experts.  Use various techniques such as interviews, surveys, and workshops to elicit business requirements.  Create detailed requirement specification documents and obtain approval from stakeholders.  Maintain a requirements traceability matrix to ensure all requirements are addressed throughout the project lifecycle.  Collaborate with technical teams to ensure a clear understanding of requirements and provide clarifications as needed.    Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT)    Design and execute comprehensive UAT plans, including test cases, scenarios, and acceptance criteria.  Coordinate with end-users to schedule and conduct UAT sessions.  Collect and document user feedback during UAT, categorising issues by priority and severity.  Work with development teams to address defects or issues identified during UAT.  Ensure thorough documentation of UAT results and obtain formal sign-off from business stakeholders.    Development of Training Materials and User Documentation    Collaborate with subject matter experts to gather information for training materials.  Create step-by-step guides, FAQs, and user manuals to support new software solutions.  Develop and deliver virtual training sessions to ensure effective user adoption.  Continuously update documentation based on user feedback and software updates.  Provide ongoing support to users, addressing questions or issues related to new software. result.description:
About the Company

OnSpec DAQ Pty Ltd is an Australian company delivering intelligent and innovative engineering solutions to the Oil & Gas industry. The company specialises in wireline services, data acquisition systems, reservoir evaluation and engineering support, providing high-quality technical services through safe, efficient and innovative operational practices.

Our commitment is to deliver engineering excellence while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality and environmental responsibility across all operations.

The Role

OnSpec is seeking an experienced Petroleum Engineer – Logging Technician (Wireline Services) to join our team in Chinchilla, Queensland.

This permanent full-time role combines petroleum engineering responsibilities with specialist wireline logging operations. The successful applicant will support reservoir evaluation, drilling, well completion, production optimisation and well intervention activities while providing technical leadership during wireline field operations.

The position requires a strong understanding of petroleum engineering principles together with practical experience in wireline logging services to support clients throughout exploration and production operations.

Key Responsibilities

Plan, design and optimise well intervention and reservoir evaluation programs to maximise hydrocarbon recovery.
Analyse geological, petrophysical and reservoir data to support drilling, completion and production decisions.
Develop engineering solutions to improve well productivity and operational efficiency.
Monitor well performance and recommend remedial actions based on engineering analysis.
Design and evaluate well completion and production strategies in accordance with engineering standards.
Provide technical support during drilling, completion and intervention operations.
Assess operational risks and ensure compliance with Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE) requirements.
Prepare engineering reports, technical recommendations and operational documentation.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including geologists, drilling engineers and production engineers.
Review operational results and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
Operate wireline logging equipment to obtain accurate downhole formation and well integrity data.
Conduct open-hole and cased-hole logging operations in accordance with company procedures and client specifications.
Perform equipment testing, calibration and functional checks before field operations.
Interpret logging data to support reservoir evaluation and well diagnostics.
